notes.title: Major Update : The Royal Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

It's time for a new major update with version 1.9.4, with new content and quality of life improvements.

[h3]Patchnote :[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a round system[/b]

[i]Each 3 maps a round recap screen is displayed and the mechanic of the maps changes. It has some stats about the previous round and a small explanation of how the incoming mechanic works.
It should help to make sure everyone understand how the next 3 maps will work, and show how the opposite team is doing.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/878b0ebf2b47a72a6dc09d8a173ed06537ec799d.png[/img]

[*] [b]Added a new environment : Medieval maps[/b]

[i]Find your way around the castle walls in the new maps.[/i]

[*] [b]Added 3 king maps[/b]

[i]Bring back the king to the village to win. Be carefull, he does as he pleases.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/83319d21a0492c575a7acf1f6aa41f5ef1d50b47.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added 3 guard maps[/b]

[i]Guards are being very vigilant. They will run to you as soon as you walk in front of them and ask you a question about this game.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/9bbd46fee7c3b12fe08a0f4d61055b4eabf462c8.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Added basic levels to the level selection screen[/b]

[i]You can now ban the basic levels (without any mechanic) in the level selection screen.[/i]

[*] [b]Bug fixes and polish[/b]

[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8.4 : The Very Necessary Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !
The first update is finally here :)
Feedbacks I've gotten on the game since the release have been overall : [i]"it has multiple flaws, but the core gameplay is really fun"[/i]. I have tried to address some of those flaws as well as I could, in my opinion it makes the game so much better !

I'll still be working on this game, so let me know what should be improved in the next update.

[h2]Patchnote :[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked the way questions are displayed from the ground up ![/b]

[i]Questions now have a background, and are pushed away from the player.
The player and the obstacle are both outlined when answering a question
The game should look way less messy and looks much better as a result.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/b97ad483e7f0abcd8bc6a06886c9ea4a5310fd91.png[/img]

[*][b]Added level selection menu[/b]

[i]You can now ban levels you do not want to play on in the settings.[/i]

[*][b]Improved the half-answer curse[/b]

[i]The curse that hides half of each answer now behave better with composed words and dates, to avoid situation where all the visible start of each words are the same.[/i]

[*][b]Improved answer layout for gamepads[/b]

Answers are now displayed according to the layout of button of a gamepad when the game detects that you are playing with one. It should make selecting an answer with a gamepad much less confusing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/f4c093094158858cdaa0bb68ebb189c78e64dd6c.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Added 3 chef boars maps[/b]

[i]Chef boars ask you to find the wrong ingredient of a recipe, you can then control them for a little while to help clear the way.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/b024f6f12ac7bac193601b3f945d02254d846817.gif[/img]

[*][b]Added 4 lost children maps[/b]

[i]Children are lost on the map, find them all and bring them to the village.
Be carefull not to bumb into them while they follow you.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/8bd221bfb983e9b4987829580b3edbb810738329.gif[/img]

[*][b]Added 3 Hiker maps[/b]

[i]You can't see much in these new maps. Answer the hikers questions to reveal the map.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/6351518c7ea61252aa25c5c3ca667c81c0447157.gif[/img]

[*][b]Removed duplicates...a lot of them[/b]

[i]For some reasons a lot of questions were repeated over in over in the database.[/i]

[*][b]As a side effect, questions may be harder overall now[/b]

[i]I reworked the way I was getting my questions to avoid duplicates, but I had to be a little less strict on the difficulty. We will see how it goes.[/i]

[*][b]Bugfixes and polish[/b]

[/list]

notes.title: Major update incoming !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm not been able to work on this game after its release, but I finally took the time to work on it again :)

I just finished remaking from the ground up the way questions are displayed. It should way less confusing now, and much cleaner. In my opinion it also looks much better !
[list]
[*] Before :[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/5ae6023e3dae4c317060829253469d0470e262fa.png[/img]
[*] After:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/b97ad483e7f0abcd8bc6a06886c9ea4a5310fd91.png[/img]
[/list]

I'm not quite finished yet, I need to make this new system works with platforms and stuff, but it will be ready very soon.

This update will also include quality of life improvements, like a different layout of the answers when playing with a gamepad, to make telling which button to press for each answer much more obvious.

Finally, it will also add (at least) 2 new map mechanics to keep things fresh !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34962345/f85932a0e229a34a2bf6859ddd867685b3b55427.png[/img]
